title: 보글보글
suno_analysis_sp: K-Indie acoustic pop ballad. A warm, fingerpicked acoustic guitar plays a steady eighth-note pattern. A clean electric bass guitar enters during the chorus, playing melodic lines that follow the vocal melody. The vocals are a soft, intimate male tenor with light natural reverb. The arrangement is minimalist, focusing on the interplay between the acoustic guitar and the vocal performance. The tempo is 78 BPM in 4/4 time.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[fingerpicked acoustic guitar]

[Verse 1]
[soft male vocals]
레시피대로 했어
된장 두 숟가락
두부 한 모 넣어
보글보글 끓여
한 숟가락 떴어
아냐 이 맛 아냐
뭐가 빠진 건지 모르겠어
숟가락을 놨어

[Chorus]
[clean electric bass enters]
엄마 손 못 따라가
같은 재료야 같은 불인데
왜 다른 걸까
시간이 들어간 거야

[Outro]
[acoustic guitar fades out]
